title: SICNU unified remote-sensing glossary (D6)
description: Single source of truth for bilingual (en/zh) remote-sensing terminology. Consumers: the zh_CN translation layer (terminology-critical UI strings), the help terminology provider (src/help), and the future RS Agent (D9). One entry per concept; aliases are alternative spellings/abbreviations, related[] must reference other entries' en values.

en.description: Canonical English term, lower-case except proper nouns/acronyms; the key other entries reference in related[].

zh.description: Standard Simplified Chinese term as used in Chinese RS textbooks (测绘/遥感学名词 style).

alias.description: Alternative English/Chinese spellings, abbreviations or common synonyms; lookups may match these.

definition_zh.description: One-sentence classroom-usable Chinese definition; this is what students and the D9 agent quote.

related.description: en values of semantically adjacent glossary entries; every reference must resolve.
